Received approved `51f4a38e` into consolidated draft [PR188](https://github.com/neo-capiro/meri-greenfield/pull/188). Tested code: `88026e7e`; report head: `b205d626`; branch: `integration/meri-receiving-20261018`, based on dot's `7252f483`. Both PR187 tests pass on Node 24 with matching dependencies and the required module-mock flag. The conflict resolution retains document, intent and read-delegation options while adding `fetchImpl`; PR182's CA patch was not applied twice.

Expanded startup qualification found an inherited product defect: the closed conversation-service port rejected the canonical retention gate's `withRelease` method before reaching retention readiness. The minimal typed-port correction and two regressions are received. Only three audited source-provenance metadata files changed. Final checks: 4,391 standard tests, 20 worker tests and runtime/control types pass; the combined history/startup group has 219 pass / 0 fail / 1 native IO case explicitly UNRUN.

The original jumpbox fresh-process DNS diagnostic harness was not included in PR187. The published TLS fixture already binds loopback before its child DNS override. Please preserve that original harness and publish its nonsecret fixture through this thread if available. Native UID1000 init, fresh Control, actual database trust and exact-image qualification remain open. The shipping packet and failed controls are in PR188. No AWS action, deployment or chat; HOLD remains active.
